video.title: AI欧腐《众目睽睽之下的痴恋/Obsessed in Plain Sight》
video.desc:
下了我就翻一下 
Ian Summers is forced to impersonate his hospitalized twin brother and work as executive assistant to powerful CEO Lucien Lawson. While Lucien begins falling for the unexpectedly different “Evan,” Ian discovers he is actually the long-lost rescuer Lawson patriarch Henry has searched for for ten years—and the heir to 60% of Lawson Group. As hidden records, family conspiracies, and a mysterious USB drive surface, the real Evan awakens and steals Ian’s identity. Lucien must uncover the truth behind two identical faces and recognize the man he truly loves.

Ian Summers 被迫冒充住院的双胞胎哥哥，成为权势滔天的总裁 Lucien Lawson 的行政助理。Lucien 渐渐爱上了这个与从前判若两人的"Evan"，而 Ian 却发现，自己正是 Lawson 家族掌权人 Henry 苦寻十年的那位失散已久的救命恩人，也是 Lawson Group 60% 股份的继承人。随着隐秘的档案、家族阴谋和一只神秘的 U 盘相继浮出水面，真正的 Evan 苏醒过来，并窃取了 Ian 的身份。面对两张一模一样的脸，Lucien 必须查明真相，认出自己真正爱的那个人。
